creator.description:
Keeping Bluesky safe.

My DMs are open if you have any questions/suggestions.

locales.description: Expresses ableism through slurs, derogatory language, or mockery of people with disabilities—including insults tied to cognitive, developmental, or physical differences.
locales.name: Ableism

locales.description: Expresses anti-Asian or Sinophobic bias, stereotypes, or hatred—including scapegoating, slurs, and dehumanization targeting Chinese, East Asian, or broader Asian communities.
locales.name: Anti-Asian Hatred

locales.description: Expresses anti-Black bias or racialized contempt—whether through erasure, dog whistles, scapegoating, or dismissing Black voices as illegitimate or harmful. This includes framing Black political dissent as sabotage or foreign interference.
locales.name: Anti-Black Racism

locales.description: Expresses antisemitic views, stereotypes, slurs, or hatred targeting Jewish people.
locales.name: Antisemitism

locales.description: Blames Muslim voters in Dearborn, Michigan for the 2024 U.S. election results, and Kamala Harris’s loss. 'Dearborn' used as a catch-all term for all Muslim-American voters.
locales.name: Dearborn Scapegoating

locales.description: Obsessively argues in bad faith, demands “debate” on human rights or genocide, or derails threads with pedantic, contrarian whataboutism. Typically refuses to engage in good-faith dialogue and attempts to dominate conversations through volume or derailment.
locales.name: Debate Lord

locales.description: Defends or minimizes the failures of the Democratic Party, its leadership, or elected officials by deflecting criticism, lowering expectations, or framing symbolic gestures as meaningful progress despite inaction or complicity in harmful policies.
locales.name: Democratic Apologia

locales.description: Amplifies or spreads disinformation and conspiracy theories designed to delegitimize Palestinian suffering and dismiss war crimes evidence in Gaza—often recycling narratives popularized by external disinformation campaigns, including the so-called 'Gazawood' and 'Pallywood' hoaxes.
locales.name: Gaza Disinfo Spreader

locales.description: Denies, downplays, or justifies the genocide of Palestinians in Gaza, including attempts to minimize civilian casualties, erase context, or deny the scale of violence inflicted.
locales.name: Gaza Genocide Denier

locales.description: Mocks or trivializes the suffering, displacement, or genocide of Palestinians in Gaza.
locales.name: Gaza Mockery

locales.description: Follows an account identified for spreading disinformation and conspiracy theories to delegitimize Palestinian suffering and dismiss war crimes evidence—such as the so-called 'Gazawood' narrative used to discredit genuine documentation from Gaza.
locales.name: Gaza Disinfo Follower

locales.description: Mocks, gloats over, or takes pleasure in others’ suffering—often using 'FAFO' to justify harm as deserved. Includes blaming entire communities for political outcomes, regardless of how individuals actually voted.
locales.name: Gloats Over Harm

locales.description: Expresses homophobic views, slurs, or hatred targeting lesbian, gay, or queer people—including mockery, harassment, or denial of LGBTQ+ identities or rights.
locales.name: Homophobia

locales.description: Expresses anti-Muslim bias, stereotypes, or hatred.
locales.name: Islamophobia

locales.description: Justifies or defends Israeli military aggression or state violence—including against Palestinians and other states—by downplaying harm, deflecting criticism, or framing resistance as illegitimate.
locales.name: Israel Apologia

locales.description: Blames Latino voters or Latino communities for political or electoral outcomes—often framing them as responsible for right-wing victories or policy setbacks, while erasing the diversity of political views within these communities.
locales.name: Latino Scapegoating

locales.description: Blames leftists or progressives for election outcomes, such as attributing Trump's 2024 victory to voters or activists who opposed the Democratic candidate from the left.
locales.name: Leftist Scapegoating

locales.description: Spams or hijacks conversations with pro-Trump memes, conspiracy rhetoric, or culture war bait—often fixated on 'woke' narratives, Democrats, or political enemies.
locales.name: MAGA Troll

locales.description: Expresses misogynistic views, contempt, or hatred toward women—including harassment, slurs, and attempts to control or demean women.
locales.name: Misogyny

locales.description: Repetitively replies with political memes, or incoherent political phrases—often unrelated to the conversation. Typically low-effort, copy-pasted, or bot-like in tone.
locales.name: Political Spammer

locales.description: Expresses racist views, slurs, dehumanization, or hateful stereotypes targeting any racial or ethnic group.
locales.name: Racism

locales.description: Spams or derails conversations with Democratic Party talking points, resistance-style memes, or incoherent replies—often accusing critics of being MAGA, Russian bots, or secretly supporting Trump.
locales.name: Resist Troll

locales.description: Blames trans people, trans rights, or trans visibility for broader societal or political problems—often framing them as a political liability or electoral threat.
locales.name: Trans Scapegoating

locales.description: Expresses transphobic views, slurs, mockery, or hatred targeting trans people—including denial of trans identities, harassment, or dehumanization. Includes exorsexism (enbyphobia), or exclusion and invalidation of nonbinary identities.
locales.name: Transphobia

locales.description: Denies, downplays, or justifies the role of the United States in enabling the genocide of Palestinians in Gaza—through the supply of weapons, diplomatic protection, and political support to Israel—since the October 7, 2023 attacks.
locales.name: Denies US Genocide Role

locales.description: Misuses allegations of antisemitism to silence, discredit, or attack critics of Israel or supporters of Palestinian rights.
locales.name: Weaponizes Antisemitism

locales.description: Misuses accusations of racism to silence, belittle, or discredit others—often to defend political figures, deflect criticism of institutions, or shut down legitimate discourse. This includes making unsubstantiated claims of racism to shield Democratic Party leaders or dismiss opposing viewpoints.
locales.name: Weaponizes Racism
